name: Catch
summary: An AI executive assistant for scheduling, inbox triage, travel and outbound calls, reached through ordinary chat and email rather than an app. Closed beta.

claims.value: No app to manage: reached through Slack, Messages, email or a phone call, and a scheduling thread can be handed over simply by copying in an address, free and without an account
claims.shortValue: No app; copy it on a thread

claims.value: Acts through integrations and outbound phone calls from its own cloud; no control of a browser or of the user's machine is described
Browser control is not described; form filling and booking are presented as agent actions awaiting approval
Makes outbound phone calls, and is reachable by call
Described as proactive by default, with a morning brief, daily sync, smart reminders, proactive updates, follow-ups and calendar protection
No desktop app; the product states there is no app to manage
No mobile app; the product states there is no app to manage
Slack, Messages, email and phone calls, with integrations across more than seventy tools
Described as built on the company's own AI, while the security pages disclose unnamed third-party vendors contractually barred from retaining or training on customer data
Bringing your own key is not described
US$99 a month, billed monthly and cancellable at any time, with a ten-day free trial. One scheduling feature is free and needs no account
Provider cloud, with AWS Secrets Manager and key management named; no self-hosting
A public API is not described
Described as adapting to your rhythm, priorities and preferences, with OAuth-scoped access to email and calendar; no memory viewer or editor is described
No export is described; the security pages offer revocation of access and deletion on request
SOC 2 Type II and CASA Tier-2 are listed, and AI vendors are contractually barred from retaining or training on customer data
Closed beta with limited spots, entered by answering a short eligibility questionnaire or joining a waiting list

messaging.detail: One of the four ways to chat with Catch.
Reachable through Messages; iMessage appears in the integration list.
Reachable by email, including copying it on a scheduling thread.

access.detail: Closed beta with limited spots; entry is by a short eligibility questionnaire or a waiting list. One scheduling feature is free without an account.

onYourComputer.detail: Nothing runs on the user's machine; Catch acts through integrations and phone calls from its own cloud.

worksWithoutVendor.detail: Provider-hosted with no self-hosting option. The company has not published what happens if it shuts down.

dataAfterExit.detail: Access can be revoked and data deleted on request, but no export or portability right is described.

plans.name: Catch
plans.billing: Billed monthly, cancel at any time; ten-day free trial
includes: Schedules meetings and drafts email in your voice
limits: Closed beta: a spot must be available
